Under the version number, top left: pick your game, My Summer Car (BETA) or My Winter Car. The launcher restarts on the chosen game. Everyone must be on the same game to play together.
Ready for a summer together? Your friends must pick the same path as you.

Under the version number, top left of the launcher: the game you play, My Summer Car (MSC, in BETA) or My Winter Car (MWC). The launcher restarts on the chosen game: its folder, its saves and its Steam friends. Everyone must be on the same game to play together; when joining a host on the other game, the launcher offers to switch.
My Summer Car in BETA: for now, you see and talk to each other (players, outfits, voice, chat). The rest (cars, items, jobs) comes over the next versions.
Version & updates: Check, the game (MSC / MWC), automatic update, test builds (nightly), the release notes and \"Launcher help bubbles\" (See the tour again).
